title: Atacama Compact Array Measurements of the Molecular Mass in the NGC 5044 Cooling-flow Group
question: How much molecular gas is in NGC 5044, how is it distributed in clouds and on which scales, and where are the absorbing clouds relative to the AGN, using ACA 7m+TP CO(2-1) data

data.arrays: ALMA 12m (cycle 0 and 4), ACA 7m, ACA total power

evidence.quote: has been analyzed by (cite: David2014-jn) who detected 24 clouds

what.value: Hot gas density model and temperature 0.8 keV

evidence.quote: We adapt the power-law model of the hot gas density distribution from Eq. (2) in (cite: David2017-ig)

recipe.goal: Image 7m and TP cubes and combine
recipe.method: tclean multiscale on 7m; sdimaging on TP; feather combination

recipe.goal: Fit spectrum and derive molecular masses
recipe.method: Three-Gaussian fit within 15 arcsec; masses from Galactic X_CO via moment maps and masked moments
key_parameters: moment maps over -550 to 300 km/s; S/N>=5 for moment 1,2

recipe.method: CLUMPFIND on 7m cube with 10 km/s binning; inverted cube for false detection test
imfit on cloud moment maps, alpha=5R sigma^2/(GM)
Image 12m extended data with robust -2, baselines >1000 klambda; Gaussian fits; column density and virial mass

answer_key.quantity: Total molecular mass within 15 arcsec (three Gaussians)

not_stated_but_needed: Line-free channel ranges for uvcontsub and imcontsub
Image cell size and image size
Details of the masked-moment method and Gaussian fitting settings
Which data selections for the uv-filtered mass vs scale test
score_reason: Imaging parameters mostly given, but several details missing and some internal inconsistencies.
rediscovery_reason: Public data, fairly complete imaging recipe, numeric masses and cloud properties.
